messages:
lisa-sales: Heads-up — Solstice Health needs SOC 2 artifacts + a signed vulnerability attestation letter for the Dedicated POC. They want everything by next Tue. Can we confirm what we can hand over and realistic timeline?
ethan-security: We can provide SOC 2 summary, control mappings, and SSO screenshots. For the vuln attestation we usually supply a pen-test attestation letter from our vendor. Our last pen test is 2024-09-10 (summary available). If they require company-signed letterhead, Legal needs to sign off.
maya-sre: For the Dedicated POC we can also surface sanitized logs and anonymized traces. We'll need the buyer to confirm exactly which logs/retention they want so we can redact IPs.
jon-eng: I can pull deployment diagrams, network topology, and the VPC peering/runbook. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
lisa-sales: They also asked about customer-managed KMS and network segmentation details. @ethan-security can you confirm the public docs link and whether we can share a sample config?
ethan-security: Yes — KMS docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/private/kms. We can share a templated `kms-setup.yml` (no keys or credentials included).
maya-sre: Note: we don't offer HSM in on-prem by default; if they need HSM/HSM-backed KMS that impacts pricing and lead time. @lisa-sales pls add to quote.
lisa-sales: Added. They also requested a pen-test liability attestation. Legal wants exact wording before signing. @audit-bot can you attach the standard attestation template?
audit-bot: Attached internal template: /assets/templates/pen_test_attestation_v2.pdf. Reviewer list: ethan-security, legal@redwood.com.
ethan-security: :thumbsup: I'll review and loop in Legal. If Legal requests changes, expect a 48–72h turn for draft and up to 5 business days for a signed letter. We can provide a vendor notarized attestation faster if needed.
jon-eng: For POC creds we can provide short-lived staging creds. Example command (no secrets shown): `rwctl create-poc --env staging --ttl 72h`
lisa-sales: Thanks — I'll propose this timeline to the buyer: SOC 2 artifacts + diagrams by EOD tomorrow, pen-test attestation draft in ~48h, signed letter within 5 business days. Any final blockers?
maya-sre: Blocker: if they request unredacted logs we need a DPA amendment and Legal review. Call that out now.
ethan-security: Also ask buyer to confirm pen-test scope (app-only vs infra+app). Attestation wording depends on that.
lisa-sales: Will ask scope and request their legal contact. I'll update the thread when Legal confirms signature date. Thanks all!
